Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement packet for the upcoming board review (planned Oct 2), we need a short catalogue of security and privacy artifacts to attach to the RFP response. Specifically, the procurement team is asking for: 

- A redlineable Data Protection Addendum (state-specific annex is acceptable)
- SOC 2 Type II summary or attestation URL (we will request full report under NDA if needed)
- CAIQ and SIGLite responses (or an itemized summary of high-critical controls)
- Any notes on DPIA considerations for processing patient-adjacent data and SCCs / SCC applicability

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the above by Sep 22? If you have a point of contact on legal or compliance we can loop in that would be helpful.

Also please include a single-statement contact for incident notification timelines for our cybersecurity office.

Hi Susan / Laura,

Thanks — I reviewed the state addendum draft and the procurement requirements. A few notes up-front:

1) DPA redlines: Ive suggested limited-edit redlines in the attached Word doc. Main points: clarify subprocessors list and MSA carve-outs for dedicated/private deployments; tighten incident notification language around 1 hour initial notice and 72-hour regulator escalation window; add a definition of personal data consistent with state statute.
2) CAIQ / SIG: we cannot publish a full SIG to the public, but we can provide an excerpted controls mapping and a SIGLite spreadsheet that maps each high/med control to Redwood artifacts (policy, SOC2 control ref, console logs). See attached excerpt (SIG_response_excerpt.xlsx).
3) DPIA / SCCs: for the DPIA please share a short scope (what categories of personal data, workflows and retention expectations). Well flag where SCCs apply for cross-border processing; Redwood supports SCCs and will include model contract language in the annex if needed.

If helpful, I can join a short call next week with your DPIA lead to walk the controls mapping. Proposed slots: Mon 9/20 10:00-11:00 or Tue 9/21 14:00-15:00 ET.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
